notes.title: Light Fall: A Clicker RPG Prologue Update v1.80
notes.content: [h3]Light Fall: A Clicker RPG v1.80 is Live and is the Final version of the Prologue that will be available until release December 5th (Aside from any hot fixes that might be needed).[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Update 1.80 is the BIGGEST UPDATE and Includes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated Enemy Balance[/p][/*][*][p]Russian Language Translation Provided by Nikita Mikhalev: [url="https://bsky.app/profile/doppelgangerra.bsky.social"]https://bsky.app/profile/doppelgangerra.bsky.social[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Gallery Mode (Unlocks after beating New Game +)[/p][/*][*][p]New Game + Doubles all enemy health in game AND you only have 30 seconds to beat each dungeon / area[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]v1.80 Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Patched the infinite use of an ability[/p][/*][*][p]Okay so apparently CLICKING damage in Light Fall wasn't accurate to how it was supposed to work this entire time?! How the hell was that missed??? Thousands of people played this game and no one noticed that the math wasn't mathing?????????[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]I will have new projects come out between that time. It's all a matter of patience as I try to juggle making games with zero budget while also working full time at my job IRL.[/p][p align="start"]I thank you all that support me even if you can't give me monetary support, you give me hope and that's something we could all use right now.[/p][p align="start"]Yes the Mac port is still on the way and hopefully by the end of this month.[/p][p align="start"]As for the Android port it's only available through the $5+ Tier on my Subscribestar BUT I will have it available on itch for a short time this weekend if you want to get it there.[/p]

notes.title: Thank You + New Release Date
notes.content: [h1][b]Thank You Everyone who wishlisted Light Fall: A Clicker RPG so far, let's keep it up![/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677071/5bfef4d0e7fb09a44c677360f8bff5a8637e17e5.gif"][/img][/p][p]For those that are following closely you may have noticed the release date being pushed back and that's because of dealing with re-indexing all of my games for itch and maintaining the Chaos Brothel website. Now on top of that the game has been pushed back even further! What was supposed to be a mid September release will now be an early December release. Not because of feature creep or because it wouldn't release on time but because of the sudden and HYPED release of Silksong, go figure.[/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime the Prologue will receive another update soon (1.75 was meant to be the last but since I have more time why not?) v1.80 will add:[/p][list][*][p]a Russian language option translated from my English script by [url="http://doppelgangerra.bsky.social%E2%80%AC/"]doppelgangerra.bsky.social‬[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Futanari Mode that will have most but not all enemies become intersex*[/p][/*][*][p]Updated New Game + Mode that will crank up the difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]Mini Gallery to unlock after New Game +[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]* This might not make it in the Prologue / Demo in time but will be in the final game![/p][p]Also a silver lining is that this game will take part in the next Steam Next Fest so I have more time for people to wishlist the game so that we can have a bigger release![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Thank You All for your support so far, PLEASE consider supporting me through Subscribstar until release: [url="https://subscribestar.adult/tamed-shame"]https://subscribestar.adult/tamed-shame[/url] even the Free Tier will get you a free copy of one of my previous games <3[/p]
